declarations: this statement and the verification-material declaration are published bytes; neither establishes key authority and neither is evidence that a rule was enforced beyond what the registration section states

log.engine: transparency-dev/tessera v1.0.4 (6bca8e8d5e23c9941f2b8a08f512b373f7131730), POSIX storage, antispam off, no witnesses
log.leaf_encoding: P10 LeafEncodeV0: 61-byte header followed by the statement bytes, registered unchanged

not_done: no authorization of issuers for particular subjects or statement types
no payload parsing and no P10 semantic check
no Registration Policy beyond the rules above
no witnesses, no key rotation, no X.509 identity path
no operator independence: one operator controls the log, the facade, the issuer table and every key
no claim of RFC 9943 or SCRAPI compliance

registration.detached_statement_payloads: when the COSE payload slot is null the signed payload must accompany the registration request; it is used for verification only and is not logged
registration.duplicates: byte-identical statements are registered once; a resubmission is authenticated again, returns the original index and the stored Receipt and appends nothing; the duplicate index is rebuilt from the log at start
registration.issuer_authentication: ES256 (alg -7) signature over the COSE Sig_structure built from the submitted protected-header bytes and the signed payload, verified against the key preconfigured in the facade for the statement's iss; protected labels are limited to 1, 3, 4 and 15; a kid, if present, must equal the thumbprint of that key; the issuer table is operator configuration supplied out of band and is never read from the log
registration.receipts: issued only after a published checkpoint covering the entry is verified with the pinned checkpoint key; COSE_Sign1, ES256, low-S, detached payload (RFC 9942 form); one Receipt key for the whole capture
registration.structural_admission: tagged COSE_Sign1 of four elements; protected header is one CBOR map without duplicate labels whose CWT claims (label 15) hold text iss and sub; empty unprotected header; payload a byte string or null; signature a byte string

status: candidate deployment declaration, generated by the log operator; not ratified; it confers no authority and is not read by the facade
